data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6111 opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 210.913m. During 2017 there was an unfavourable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 4.7m, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003, representing a gross strengthening of reserves (~2.23% of opening gross claims outstanding). The syndicate also noted adverse current-year pressure from a series of 2017 natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and California Wildfires) which contributed to overall adverse underwriting performance, and the 2014 year of account settlement was reflected in the movements in provisions.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavourable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 4.7m (2016: favorable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2015 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

The underwriting performance in 2017 was driven by the continuous softening of the rates across the portfolio in the market. The high incidence and magnitude of claims from natural catastrophes in the second half of 2017 such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California Wildfires added to the adverse performance.
Included within the gross and ceded change in provision for claims in the calendar year 2017 are GBP 76.9m and GBP 8.8m, respectively, relating to the settlement of the 2014 year of account.
